e-03.title: Nquma ukuthi uzobuza ini ngaphambi kokuphendula
e-03.goal: Nquma ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi oludinga ngempela ngaphambi kokuphendula umbhalo wesimemo, bese ubhala impendulo emfushane yesiNgisi ecela lolo lwazi.
e-03.material:
Utholile umbhalo ovela kumngane wakho u-Ari. "Let's play soccer tomorrow!"
Ucabanga ukuthi kuzwakala kuhle, kodwa lo mbhalo wodwa awanele ukunquma ukuthi ungaya yini.
e-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha konke okumele ukwazi ukuze uphendule u-'I can go.'
e-03.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi impendulo yombuzo ngamunye isivele ingatholakala embhalweni yini.
e-03.s.s1.hint.1: Zama umbuzo ngamunye ngokuhlukile: uma ungenayo impendulo yawo, ungasho yini 'ngizofika'?
e-03.s.s1.r.a: Isikhathi siyadingeka. Kodwa ngalokhu kuphela, awazi ukuthi uya kuphi. Hlola ukuthi okunye kuyadingeka yini.
e-03.s.s1.r.b: Indawo iyadingeka. Kodwa ngalokhu kuphela, awazi ukuthi isikhathi sini. Hlola ukuthi okunye kuyadingeka yini.
e-03.s.s1.r.c: Ibhola linhle ukuba nalo, kodwa alidingeki ukunquma ukuthi ungaya yini.
e-03.s.s1.r.d: Kungasiza, kodwa ungakwazi ukunquma ukuthi ungaya yini ngaphandle kwalo. Cabanga ukuthi ngempela ulwazi oludingekile yini.
e-03.s.s1.r.e: U-Ari usevele wathi masidlale ibhola lezinyawo. Lokhu kubuza ngento osuvele uyazi.
e-03.s.s1.r.f: Ukwazi isizathu kuhle ngokuzibuza, kodwa akudingeki ukunquma ukuthi ungaya yini. Umbuzo awudingeki nje ngoba uqala ngegama lombuzo.
e-03.s.s1.explain: Uma ungazi isikhathi nendawo, awukwazi ukunquma ukuthi kuhambisana neshejuli yakho noma ukuthi ungafika yini. Uma ukhethe okukodwa kuphela, hlola futhi: ngaphandle komunye, ungasho yini 'ngizofika'? (Uma wazi isikhathi kuphela, awazi ukuthi uya kuphi; uma wazi indawo kuphela, awazi ukuthi isikhathi sini.)
e-03.s.s1.acc.0: Kuyinto yemvelo ukufuna ukwazi ukuthi ubani ozofika nakho. Kodwa iphuzu elibaluleke kakhulu ukuthi awukwazi ukuphendula ngaphandle kwesikhathi nendawo.
e-03.s.s2.prompt: Phendula u-Ari ngesiNgisi. Khombisa ukuthi ufuna ukujoyina, futhi ufake umbuzo ocela ulwazi olukhethile ngenhla.
e-03.s.s2.hint.0: Okokuqala, bhala ibinzana elifushane elisho 'Sounds good!'
e-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ungaphinda uhlanganise imibuzo emibili oyikhethile ibe umusho owodwa.
e-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngemuva kokufunda impendulo yami, u-Ari angasho yini isikhathi nendawo?
e-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Iqukethe yini kokubili impendulo enobungane nemibuzo?

e-09.title: Ngaphambi kokuphendula umfundi omncane othi 'Could you look at it at some point?'
e-09.goal: Khetha ulwazi olushodayo esicelweni esingacacile, bese ubhala impendulo yesiNgisi ehlanganisa ngenhlonipho imibuzo oyidingayo.
e-09.material:
Utholile umlayezo ovela kumfundi onyaka o-1 ngaphansi kwakho. Anazani kahle.

"Hi! Sorry to bother you, but could you look at my essay at some point? Thanks!!"

Ufuna ukusiza, kodwa uphithene kakhulu kule viki.
e-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha konke okudingayo ukukwazi ngaphambi kokuphendula, ukuze unqume ukuthi ungasiza yini futhi usize kahle.
e-09.s.s1.hint.0: Gcizelela amagama angacacile emlayezweni, bese ubhala umugqa owodwa ngegama ngalinye ngokuthi kungani leli gama lenza isinqumo sakho sibe nzima.
e-09.s.s1.hint.1: Zama umbuzo ngamunye ngokulandelana: uma ungenayo impendulo, ungasho yini 'Yebo, ngizokwenza'?
e-09.s.s1.r.a: Isikhathi sokugcina siyadingeka. Kodwa kulokhu kuphela awazi ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo losizo oludingekayo. Hlola ukuthi ikhona yini enye imibuzo oyidingayo.
e-09.s.s1.r.b: Uhlobo losizo luyadingeka. Kodwa kulokhu kuphela awazi ukuthi kumele kwenziwe ngaphambi kwini. Hlola ukuthi ikhona yini enye imibuzo oyidingayo.
e-09.s.s1.r.c: Ubude buyadingeka ukulinganisa isikhathi. Hlola ukuthi ikhona yini enye imibuzo edingekayo nayo.
e-09.s.s1.r.d: Amamaki onyaka odlule awahlobene ngqo nokuthi ungasiza yini ngalesi sihloko, noma ukuthi ngani.
e-09.s.s1.r.e: Ukuthi banosizo olunye akushintshi ukuthi ungasiza yini, noma ukuthi ngani.
e-09.s.s1.explain: 'At some point' ayicacile ngokuthi nini, futhi 'look at' ayicacile ngohlobo losizo. Udinga ukwazi isikhathi sokugcina, usizo olufunwayo, nobude ukuze unqume ukuthi ungenza isikhathi yini. Uma ukhethe ezinye kuphela, hlola ukuthi ubungasiza yini ngaphandle kwempendulo yombuzo owushiyile.
e-09.s.s1.acc.0: Isikhathi sokugcina nohlobo losizo olufunwayo kuyizinto eziyinhloko, futhi ubude yinto owazi ngayo ngemva kokuthola, ngakho ukuyishiya kunengqondo.
e-09.s.s1.acc.1: Kunengqondo nokuthi kuqala unqume ngesikhathi sokugcina nobude ukuthi ungenza isikhathi yini, bese ubuza ngohlobo losizo kamuva.
e-09.s.s1.acc.2: Ngisho noma uphithene kule viki, ungalinganisa kuqala ukuthi ungasiza yini ngohlobo losizo oludingekayo nobude. Kodwa uzodinga ukwazi isikhathi sokugcina maduze.
e-09.s.s2.prompt: Bhalela umfundi omncane impendulo ngesiNgisi. Bonisa ngenhlonipho ukuthi uyavuma ukusiza, bese ufaka okungenani imibuzo emibili kulezo owakhethe ngenhla.
e-09.s.s2.hint.0: Nquma imibuzo emibili engashintsha ukuthi ungasiza yini, noma ukuthi ngani.
e-09.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala umbuzo owodwa ngomusho ngamunye, futhi ubeke inkulumo ngokusiza ekuqaleni ngempela.
e-09.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: Sure, I'd be happy to help! ...
e-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngemva kokufunda impendulo yami, umfundi omncane angangitshela isikhathi sokugcina nosizo afuna lona?
e-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ungakwazi ukubona kokubili isifiso sokusiza nemibuzo?

e-10.title: Ukwenqaba okuhloniphekile, noma ithuba lisekhona?
e-10.goal: Njengoba umusho ngamunye we-imeyili ehloniphekile uvezwa, buyekeza isahlulelo sakho ngenhloso yangempela yomunye, bese ubhala impendulo efanelekile.
e-10.material: Uthumele isiphakamiso sokwenza insimu yemifino yesikole ku-Ms. Rowe, obhekele esikoleni. I-imeyili yempendulo ivuleka umusho owodwa ngesikhathi.
e-10.s.s1.prompt: Funda i-imeyili ucezu ngolunye, bese ngesikhathi ngasinye ukhetha isahlulelo sakho sokuthi isiphakamiso sizamukelwa yini.
e-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala nquma ukuthi umusho omusha ushintsha incazelo yowangaphambilini noma uyaqhubeka.
e-10.s.s1.hint.1: Maka amagama ashintsha ukugeleza (But) namagama athile anjengezinsuku nezinhloso.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Siyiphi isahlulelo esinengqondo kakhulu ngalo musho kuphela?
e-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukudumisa kuphela akubonisi isinqumo. Kungaba isiqalo sokwenqaba okuthambile, noma nje isibingelelo. Umusho olandelayo uyabalulekile.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Interesting' ukudumisa, kodwa akulona igama lesinqumo noma lokuvuma.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Asikwazi ukwazi isinqumo okwamanje, futhi sidinga ukubona umusho olandelayo.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Inkulumo yebanga 'this year' iyabalulekile. Uma uyifunde njengo-'ukwenqaba okuhloniphekile' esinyathelweni sokuqala, lo musho usekela lokho kufunda, kodwa akukhona ukwenqaba unomphelo okwamanje.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Isho ukuthi lo nyaka unzima, futhi ayisho lutho okwamanje ngemuva.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kusho ukwenqaba okuphelele kusukela manje, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi unyaka.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Yasho kuphela 'this year's budget.' Ayizange isho ukwenqaba unomphelo.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kuyinkinga yohlahlo lwabiwo mali kuphela, ngakho izoxazululwa maduze futhi singaqala lo nyaka.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Yathi uhlahlo lwabiwo mali selivele lamiswa.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Funda kuze kube umusho wokugcina bese uhlulela futhi.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukugeleza kushintsha nge-'But', futhi isikhathi sokugcina (Friday), inhloso (director), nesikhathi (March) kuthile. Noma ukufunde njengokungakanqunywa noma njengenhloso yokuqhubeka, uma bewunqume ngokuqinile 'ukwenqaba okuhloniphekile' ngaphambili, udinga ukubuyekeza isahlulelo sakho.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yinhlonipho nje, ngakho akukho sidingo sokuphendula.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Umuntu ofuna ukwenqaba kuphela akanikezi isikhathi sokugcina (Friday) nenhloso (director, March) ngemininingwane.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Akakanquli ukuthi uzwenqaba yini, futhi uqoqa ulwazi ukuze ahlulele.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lokhu nakho kungafundwa. Kodwa 'I will show it to the director before the March budget meeting' isondele kakhulu ekufuneni ukuqhubeka.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Uyathanda, futhi ucela izinto ukuze kuqhutshekwe emhlanganweni wohlahlo lwabiwo mali kaMashi.
e-10.s.s1.reflect: Tshela ukuthi isahlulelo sakho sishintshe kanjani esinyathelweni sesithathu ngemuva kokuhlulela 'kunzima' esinyathelweni sesibili. Yiwaphi amagama (But, by Friday, before ... March) abe yisizathu?
e-10.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ukuthi isahlulelo sakho esinyathelweni sokuqala sihluke kanjani kwesesinyathelo sokugcina (sesithathu), nokuthi yiziphi izinkulumo ezenze sihluke. Ungabhala ngesiKorea noma ngesiNgisi. (Uma singashintshanga, bhala ukuthi kungani sihlale sinjalo.)
e-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala, bhala ngomusho owodwa ukukhetha owakwenza esinyathelweni 1.
e-10.s.s2.hint.1: Phakathi kwezinkulumo ezivele zasha esinyathelweni 3 (But, Friday, March, njll.), khetha eyodwa eshintshe isahlulelo sakho.
e-10.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: At first I thought ... but because of ...
e-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ukhethe futhi wabhala ukuthi yiyiphi inkulumo evela ku-imeyili eshintshe isahlulelo sakho?
e-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Uma singashintshanga, uchaze ukuthi kungani usebenzisa izinkomba ezivela ku-imeyili?
e-10.s.s2.model.0: At first I thought it was a polite refusal, but in the last sentence I saw that after 'But' she asked for an estimate by Friday, so I changed to thinking she is interested.
e-10.s.s3.prompt: Bhalela u-Ms. Rowe impendulo ngesiNgisi. Bonisa ukubonga nokuqonda isimo, bese uthembisa ukuthumela lokho okucelwe ngosuku olucelwe (Friday).
e-10.s.s3.hint.0: Phinda ufunde lokho okucelwayo emushweni wokugcina we-imeyili (yini, nokuthi ngaphambi kwini) bese ukuthwalela empendulweni yakho njengoba injalo.
e-10.s.s3.hint.1: Zama ukubhala ngalokhu kulandelana: umusho owodwa wokubonga, umusho owodwa wokuqonda, umusho owodwa wesithembiso.
e-10.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Thank you for your reply. ...
e-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Impendulo yakho iphendule ncamashi isicelo sokugcina sika-Ms. Rowe?
e-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kukhona yini inkulumo ebonisa ukuthi uyaqonda ukuthi uhlahlo lwabiwo mali lwalo nyaka aluvumeli?

e-01.title: Hlanganisa imigqa emibili yesaziso somtapo wezincwadi ukuhlola uhlelo luka-Ben
e-01.goal: Hlanganisa imigqa emibili ehlukile yesaziso (uhlelo oluvamile nokwehlukile kwaleli sonto), nquma usuku ngosuku ukuthi uhlelo lomngane wakho luyasebenza yini, bese umtshela ngesiNgisi.
e-01.material:
Isaziso emnyango womtapo wezincwadi wesikole (obhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho sithombe):

Library
Open: Mon, Wed, Fri  3:00-4:00
This week: closed on Friday (cleaning day).

Umngane wakho u-Ben wathi, "Let's go to the library on Thursday and on Friday this week!"
e-01.thinking.0: Hlanganisa imigqa eminingana yesaziso ukwenza isinqumo
e-01.s.s1.prompt: U-Ben angasisebenzisa yini umtapo wezincwadi ngoLwesine nangoLwesihlanu kuleli sonto, njengoba ehlela?
e-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bheka uLwesine noLwesihlanu ngokwehlukana, uqhathanise lokho umugqa ngamunye wesaziso osho ngalolo suku.
e-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi umugqa othi 'Open' nomugqa othi 'This week' benza imisebenzi ehlukile yini.
e-01.s.s1.r.a: Kungenzeka ungawafundanga yomibili imigqa yesaziso. Hlola ukuthi uLwesine ungomunye wezinsuku ezivuliwe yini, nokuthi kukhona inothi elikhethekile ngoLwesihlanu yini.
e-01.s.s1.r.c: ULwesihlanu uvame ukuvulwa, kodwa umugqa othi 'This week' usho okuhlukile ngalesi sonto.
e-01.s.s1.r.d: Bheka futhi ukuthi uLwesine ulele ohlwini lwezinsuku ezivuliwe (Open) yini.
e-01.s.s1.explain: ULwesine akayena omunye wezinsuku ezivuliwe (Mon, Wed, Fri), futhi nakuba uLwesihlanu uvame ukuvulwa, kuleli sonto 'closed on Friday'. Ngakho yomibili izinsuku azisebenzi.
e-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha yonke imigqa oyidingayo ukwahlulela uhlelo luka-Ben (uLwesine noLwesihlanu).
e-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zama ukususa umugqa ngamunye ubone ukuthi kuba nzima yini ukwahlulela uLwesine noma uLwesihlanu.
e-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gcina amazwi ka-Ben nemigqa yesaziso kwehlukene.
e-01.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu kusetshenziselwa ukwahlulela uLwesine, kodwa lo mugqa wodwa awukutsheli ngoLwesihlanu walesi sonto (uvame ukuvulwa). Hlola ukuthi udinga omunye umugqa nawo yini.
e-01.s.s2.r.b: Udinga lokhu ukwahlulela uLwesihlanu, kodwa lo mugqa awusho lutho ngoLwesine. Thola ukuthi yimuphi umugqa okuvumela ukwahlulela uLwesine.
e-01.s.s2.r.c: Isihloko kuphela, ngakho asinalo ulwazi ngezinsuku.
e-01.s.s2.r.d: Lo musho ungumphakamiso ka-Ben. Isiphakamiso siyinto yokuhlola, hhayi ubufakazi.
e-01.s.s2.explain: Umugqa othi Open ukhombisa ukuthi uLwesine akusona usuku olusevuliwe, futhi umugqa othi This week ukhombisa ukuthi uLwesihlanu uvaliwe kuleli sonto. Noma yimuphi owodwa awukwazi ukwahlulela zombili izinsuku. Uma ukhethe owodwa kuphela, hlola ukuthi yiluphi usuku olusele.
e-01.s.s3.prompt: Phendula u-Ben ngesiNgisi ngomusho owodwa noma emibili. Nikeza isizathu sokuthi awukwazi ukuya ngoLwesine nesizathu sokuthi awukwazi ukuya ngoLwesihlanu.
e-01.s.s3.hint.0: Okokuqala, bhala umusho owodwa utshela u-Ben 'cha, asikwazi.'
e-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala umusho owodwa wesizathu sikaLwesine nowodwa wesizathu sikaLwesihlanu, ngamunye uxhunywe emugqeni wesaziso.
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Unikeze yini isizathu sikaLwesine nesizathu sikaLwesihlanu?
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ungasho yini ukuthi yimuphi umugqa wesaziso lapho isizathu ngasinye sivela khona?
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uma uphakamise olunye usuku, uhlolile yini ukuthi ngempela lusuku olusevuliwe? (okungakhethwa)

e-02.title: Thola umusho owudidayo emlayezweni wesimemo
e-02.goal: Thola imisho emibili emlayezweni omfushane wesimemo engahambisani, bese uyibhala kabusha ukuze abangane bangadideki.
e-02.material: Lo ngumlayezo uJun awuthumele kubafundi ayafunda nabo. (Ubhalwe ngamagama kuphela. Umugqa ngamunye unenombolo.)
e-02.thinking.0: Thola ulwazi oluphikisana nalo phakathi kwemisho
e-02.prereq.1: Izenzo ezilula ezifana no-come / start umdlalo
e-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umusho owodwa ongadida abangane. Ungumugqa ongahambisani nomunye umusho.
e-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa 'isikhathi sokufika' 'nesikhathi sokuqala'. Yiluphi olufika kuqala?
e-02.s.s1.explain: Utshela abantu ukuthi beze ngo-10, kodwa usho ukuthi umdlalo uqala ngo-9:30. Ungashintsha noma umugqa 3 noma umugqa 4. Umugqa 1 (ipaki ngeSonto) nomugqa 2 (indawo yepaki) aluphikisani nanoma yimuphi omunye umugqa. Uma uqhathanisa imigqa enezinombolo (izikhathi), ungabona ukuphikisana.
e-02.s.s2.prompt: Kungenzeka ini uma lo mlayezo uthunyelwe njengoba unjalo?
e-02.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga umngane owamukela umlayezo ubheka iwashi enze ncamashi lokho okushiwo.
e-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa: ingabe umdlalo wawusuqalile ngesikhathi lowo mngane efika?
e-02.s.s2.o.a: Umngane ofika ngo-10 uphutha umdlalo osuvele uqalile.
e-02.s.s2.o.b: Umngane ofika ngo-9:30 ulinda epakini elingenalutho ngaphambi kokuba umdlalo uqale.
e-02.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu kungenzeka ngempela kumngane okholelwa ekuqaleni ngo-9:30 afike ngaleso sikhathi. Kodwa inkinga eqondile kakhulu edalwa ukuphikisana no-'come at 10' ngu-a.
e-02.s.s2.o.c: Abangane baphetha ngokufika ngoMgqibelo esikhundleni seSonto.
e-02.s.s2.r.c: Usuku lucacile ukuthi ngeSonto. Inkinga yisikhathi.
e-02.s.s2.explain: Inkinga incike ekutheni yiziphi phakathi kwezikhathi ezimbili olulandelayo. Uma ulandela u-10, uphutha umdlalo (a); uma ulandela u-9:30, uyadideka ngoba wehlukile kulokho okushiwo omunye umugqa (b). Noma kunjani, kwenzeka ngoba izikhathi ezimbili azihambisani.
e-02.s.s2.acc.0: Umngane okholelwa ekuqaleni ngo-9:30 afike ngaleso sikhathi alinde naye ungumphumela wangempela wokuphikisana. U-a ngowomngane olandele u-'10', futhi u-b ngowomngane olandele u-'9:30'.
e-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha imisho emibili (isikhathi sokufika nesikhathi sokuqala komdlalo) ngesiNgisi ukuze izikhathi zihambisane.
e-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ungashintsha isikhathi esisodwa kuphela kwezimbili. Nquma kuqala ukuthi yiluphi okufanele ushintshe.
e-02.s.s3.hint.1: Beka isikhathi sokufika ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuqala, bese ubhala zombili izikhathi njengezinombolo eceleni komunye ukuze uziqhathanise.
e-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Phakathi kwezikhathi ezimbili owazibhalile, yiluphi olwangaphambili? Isikhathi sokufika siza kuqala yini?
e-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ucabange yini ukuthi umngane uzokwenza kanjani ngemuva kokufunda lo mlayezo?

e-04.title: UJun ufunani? Buyekeza ukucabanga kwakho njengoba kwengezwa izinkomba
e-04.goal: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho kwengezwa inkomba engxoxweni, qagela futhi ukuthi umkhulumi ufunani, bese uchaza ukuthi ukuqagela kwakho kushintshe kanjani.
e-04.material: Ekhaya, uJun ukhuluma nomama wakhe. Amazwi akhe azokhonjiswa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi.
e-04.prereq.0: Amagama alula afana no-small, hurt, closed
e-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda amazwi kaJun ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi, futhi isikhathi ngasinye qagela ukuthi uJun ufunani.
e-04.s.s1.hint.0: Thola igama elilodwa elisha kulolu cezu.
e-04.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ngamunye ukuthi ukuqagela kwakho kwangaphambili kufanela yini inkomba entsha.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yikuphi ukuqagela okunengqondo kakhulu ngalokho uJun akufunayo kumama wakhe, kulo musho wodwa?
e-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Awukwazi ukwazi ncamashi ngomusho owodwa. Angase afune izicathulo ezintsha, noma angase asho nje iqiniso.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Azikho izinkomba eziphathelene nekilasi le-P.E. noma ukweqa.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Unethemba lokuthi umama wakhe uzomthengela izicathulo ezintsha.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Angase athi nje izicathulo zakhe zincane.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Jun: "They hurt when I run. We have P.E. (physical education) class tomorrow."
e-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Funda inkomba entsha bese uqagela futhi ukuthi uJun ufunani.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.after: U-'It hurts' no-'P.E. tomorrow' ndawonye kwenza kucace ukuthi ufuna kuxazululwe ngomuso. Uma ucabange esinyathelweni sokuqala ukuthi 'ushiwo iqiniso nje', udinga ukubuyekeza ukuqagela kwakho lapha.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ufuna ukulungisa ukuze izinyawo zakhe zingalimali ngaphambi kwekilasi le-P.E. ngomuso.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukusho ukuthi izinyawo zakhe ziyalimala futhi unayo i-P.E. ngomuso yinkomba yokuthi ufuna kuxazululwe. Lokho bekungenzeka esinyathelweni sokuqala, kodwa manje akuhambisani nezinkomba.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Akazange athi ufuna ukweqa. Ukuyifunda njengokufuna isixazululo ku-'it hurts' no-'P.E. tomorrow' kusondele ezinkombeni.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Funda inkomba yokugcina bese uqagela ukuthi uJun uzokwenzani.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Isitolo sivaliwe namuhla, ngakho u-'new shoes today' uvinjiwe. Amacebo afana nokuya kwesinye isitolo noma ukukhuluma ngezicathulo zomngani zombili ziyahambisana nenkomba entsha. Uma ucabange izicathulo ezintsha kuphela, udinga ukushintsha uhlelo lwakho lokuzithenga namuhla.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Uya esitolo namuhla bese ethenga izicathulo ezintsha.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Akuhambisani nenkomba yokuthi isitolo sivaliwe namuhla.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ucela unina ukuthi aye kwesinye isitolo ekuseni kakhulu ngomuso.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lena nayo yinhloso engenzeka. Kodwa umbono uJun awuletha ekugcineni mayelana nomngani.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ucabanga ukuboleka izicathulo kumngani onosayizi wonyawo ofanayo.
e-04.s.s1.reflect: Ingabe ukuqagela kwakho kwashintsha esinyathelweni ngasinye? Uma kwashintsha, qamba umusho owodwa owawuyisizathu.
e-04.s.s2.prompt: Iyiphi inkomba eyenza isifiso sikaJun sifundeke sisuka ku-'just saying' siye ku-'solving it by tomorrow'?
e-04.s.s2.hint.0: Funda izinkomba ezintathu ngokulandelana bese uthola lapho inani lokuqagela okungenzeka lanciphisa kuqala.
e-04.s.s2.hint.1: Funda ngokususa inkomba ngayinye bese uhlola ukuthi incazelo ethi 'ufuna ukuyilungisa' isahlala yini.
e-04.s.s2.r.b: Lo musho ubukhona kusukela ekuqaleni, futhi yodwa wawuvumela ukuqagela okuningana.
e-04.s.s2.r.c: Le nkomba yavimba indlela eyodwa yokuxazulula (isitolo), kodwa isifiso sokuxazulula sasivele sibonisiwe yizinkomba zangaphambilini.
e-04.s.s2.explain: U-'It hurts' no-'P.E. tomorrow' kudala inkinga enomkhawulo wesikhathi, ngakho uJun ufundeka njengofuna kuxazululwe.

e-05.title: Ukutshela abantu abahlukene ngesimo esifanayo
e-05.goal: Bhala ngesiNgisi mayelana nesimo esifanayo (ukweqa iklabhu ngenxa yokubonana nodokotela wamazinyo) kuthisha nakumngani, ngalinye liphimbo nobude obufanele.
e-05.material: There is an English club today at 3:30, but you have a dentist appointment at the same time, so you can't go. Udinga ukutshela uthisha weklabhu, uMs. Han, ngomyalezo, nomngani weklabhu efanayo ngombhalo omfushane.
e-05.thinking.0: Qhathanisa futhi ukhethe izisho ngokuya ngomuntu nesimo
e-05.thinking.1: Bhala ukuze uhlangabezane nezimo zenhlonipho nobude
e-05.prereq.0: Izisho ezinenhlonipho ezifana no-could / would / please
e-05.prereq.1: Isisho esithi I have a ... appointment
e-05.s.s1.prompt: Ngumuphi umyalezo ongcono kakhulu ongawuthumela kuMs. Han? (Uzobhalela umngani wakho esinyathelweni esilandelayo.)
e-05.s.s1.hint.0: Funa ukuxolisa noma isicelo emyalezweni ngamunye.
e-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ziqhathanise ngokucabanga ukuthi uthisha uzozwa kanjani lapho ewamukela umyalezo ngamunye.
e-05.s.s1.r.b: Isizathu nesimo kuyacaca, kodwa ngaphandle kokuxolisa noma isicelo kungazwakala sengathi umemezela nje kuthisha.
e-05.s.s1.r.c: Unikeza isizathu kodwa uzwakala sengathi uphosa icala, okungakhathaza omunye umuntu.
e-05.s.s1.r.d: Iphimbo liyobungane kodwa lisenenhlonipho. Uhlelo lolimi nalo lulungile.
e-05.s.s1.explain: U-a no-d banokuxolisa, isizathu, nesicelo. U-a usemthethweni kakhulu futhi u-d ulula, kodwa bobabili banenhlonipho. U-b ucacile futhi uhloniphekile, kodwa ngaphandle kokuxolisa noma isicelo ungafundeka njengonenhlonipho encane. Ku-c, iphimbo lokuphosa icala lingenza omunye umuntu angakhululeki. Izinga lokusemthethweni elilindelekile liyahluka ngesikole nangothisha.
e-05.s.s1.acc.0: Uma usondelene nothisha, iphimbo lobungane elinenhlonipho njengo-d nalo liyahambisana. U-a uyisisho esisemthethweni kakhulu.
e-05.s.s1.acc.1: U-b unesizathu nesimo esicacile nesihloko esinenhlonipho (Ms. Han), ngakho ulungile njengesaziso esifushane. Kodwa ngaphandle kokuxolisa noma isicelo, ungafundeka njengonenhlonipho encane kuno-a no-d.
e-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala wena umyalezo kuMs. Han. Sho ukuthi awukwazi ukuza nesizathu (ukubonana nodokotela wamazinyo), futhi ufake isisho esinenhlonipho (ukuxolisa noma isicelo).
e-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ucabange ukuthi ungangeza ini uma ukhuluma nothisha wakho ngesiKorea, bese uthola ukuthi usho kanjani leyo ncazelo ngesiNgisi.
e-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukubhala ngalokhu kulandelana: umusho wokungezi, umusho wesizathu, umusho wesicelo.
e-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe iphimbo liyilona elingeke likhathaze uthisha lapho ekufunda? Yiliphi igama elenza lowo msebenzi?
e-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Uma ungeze okuthile ofuna (njengokuthola izinto), ingabe kuzwakala njengesicelo?
e-05.s.s3.prompt: Kulokhu kungumbhalo kumngani weklabhu efanayo. Bhala isimo esifanayo ngokufushane ngamagama angu-18 noma ngaphansi, ngephimbo elingasemthethweni. (Ungasebenzisi izisho ezisemthethweni ezifana no-Dear noma u-I'm afraid.)
e-05.s.s3.hint.0: Gcina ulwazi kuphela okumele ulugcine emyalezweni wakho kuthisha (isizathu, nokuthi awukwazi ukuza).
e-05.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa izifinyezo (can't) noma amagama amafushane, futhi ubale amagama.
e-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Uma uqhathanisa nalokho obukubhalele uthisha, yiwaphi amagama anyamalele futhi yiwaphi ahlala?
e-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Nakuba kufushane, ingabe umngani wakho angasazi isizathu?

e-06.title: Thola imisho enezikhathi ezigxumayo emyalezweni weqembu
e-06.goal: Thola imisho emibili yohlelo emyalezweni weqembu engahambisani, chaza ukuthi ingabangela kuphi ukudideka, bese uyibhala kabusha.
e-06.material: Lo ngumyalezo umholi wephrojekthi yeqembu yesayensi awushicilele ku-chat yeqembu. (Umugqa ngamunye unenombolo. Izikhathi zantambama zibhalwe njengo-p.m.)
e-06.prereq.0: by / before / after + usuku noma isikhathi
e-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umusho owodwa ongabangela inkinga kumalungu eqembu alandela uhlelo. Ngumugqa lapho ukulandelana kwesikhathi kungahambisani nomunye umusho.
e-06.s.s1.hint.0: Thola yonke imigqa enezikhathi, bese ubeka izikhathi ngokulandelana kwesikhathi.
e-06.s.s1.hint.1: Yiliphi elivela kuqala: usuku lokugcina lokuthumela noma isikhathi sokuhlanganisa?
e-06.s.s1.explain: Isikhathi sokuhlanganisa singoLwesine 4:30 p.m., kodwa usuku lokugcina lwezingxenye ngoLwesine 9:00 p.m. Usuku lokugcina luhambile kunesikhathi sokuhlanganisa, ngakho imigqa emibili (umugqa 2 nomugqa 3) iyaphikisana. Imigqa 1 no-4 imayelana nosuku lokugcina lwangoLwesihlanu nokuphrinta, ngakho ayiphikisani.
e-06.s.s2.prompt: Kwakuzokwenzekani ngempela uma abantu belandela lo myalezo njengoba unjalo?
e-06.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ilungu leqembu lithumela ingxenye yalo ngqo ku-'Thursday night'.
e-06.s.s2.o.a: Ingxenye eyenziwa ngo-9 ingase ingafike lapho izingxenye zihlanganiswa ngo-4:30.
e-06.s.s2.o.b: Zonke izingxenye zifika ngaphambi komsebenzi wokuhlanganisa, ngakho iphosta liqedwa ekuseni.
e-06.s.s2.r.b: Umsebenzi wokuhlanganisa ungo-4:30 p.m., futhi izingxenye zamukelwa kuze kube ngu-9:00 p.m. Qhathanisa izikhathi futhi.
e-06.s.s2.o.c: Asisekho isikhathi sokuphrinta ngaphambi kwekilasi ngoLwesihlanu.
e-06.s.s2.r.c: Inkinga ukulandelana ngaphakathi kukaLwesine. Kusekhona isikhathi kuze kube sekuseni ngoLwesihlanu.
e-06.s.s2.explain: Ukuhlanganisa kuza kuqala, kodwa izingxenye zamukelwa kamuva kunalokho, ngakho ingxenye ethunyelwe sekwephuzile ingashiywa.
e-06.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha owodwa wemigqa eyiphikisanayo (noma yomibili) ngesiNgisi. Yenza izikhathi nezinsuku kuhambisane.
e-06.s.s3.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuthi isikhathi sawuphi emigqeni emibili oshintshayo.
e-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ngemva kokushintsha, funda futhi ukuhlola ukuthi ukulandelana 'usuku lokugcina lezingxenye → ukuhlanganisa → ukuphrinta' kulungile ngezikhathi.
e-06.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Please send me your part by ...
e-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usuku lokugcina lokwamukela izingxenye luza ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuhlanganisa? Qhathanisa izikhathi ezimbili njengezinombolo.
e-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe kusekhona isikhathi ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina lwekuseni ngoLwesihlanu?
e-06.s.s3.modelNote.0: Ngishintshe usuku lokugcina lwezingxenye lwaba ngaphambilini.
e-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ngishintshe isikhathi sokuhlanganisa lwaba kamuva futhi ngengeze isizathu.

e-07.title: Hlanganisa izaziso ezimbili ukuze usebenze isikhathi sokuhamba kwebhasi
e-07.goal: Hlanganisa izaziso ezimbili ezibekwe ngezinsuku ezahlukene (isikhathi sokuqala nokushintsha kwakamuva) ukusebenza isikhathi esisha sokuhamba, futhi ulungise ukungaqondi kukamngani usebenzisa ubufakazi.
e-07.material:
Izaziso ezimbili zibekwe ebhodini lezaziso esiteshini sebhasi. (Kubhalwe ngamagama kuphela.)

Notice A (posted on Monday): "Bus 5 leaves at 7:40 a.m."
Notice B (posted on Wednesday): "From Thursday, Bus 5 will leave 10 minutes earlier. Please be at the stop on time."

Your friend Hana: "Bus 5 leaves at 7:50 on Thursday."
Your friend Jae: "Then on Friday it leaves at the same time as on Thursday."
e-07.thinking.0: Hlanganisa izingcezu eziningana zolwazi ukuze ufinyelele esiphethweni
e-07.thinking.1: Qonda ukuthi isaziso sakamuva sishintsha kanjani sangaphambilini
e-07.prereq.0: Izisho ezifana no-earlier / later / from + usuku
e-07.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa izinsuku lapho izaziso ezimbili zabekwa. Yisiphi esakamuva?
e-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi u-earlier usho 'ngaphambilini' noma 'kamuva', bese ubala kusuka ku-7:40.
e-07.s.s1.o.a: Ulungile. Ukwengeza imizuzu eyi-10 ka-B ku-7:40 ka-A kunika u-7:50.
e-07.s.s1.r.a: Kungenzeka ufunde u-earlier sengathi uthi 'later'. Hlola incazelo ka-earlier futhi.
e-07.s.s1.o.b: Akalungile. U-B uthi uhamba ngemizuzu eyi-10 ngaphambilini, ngakho kungu-7:30.
e-07.s.s1.o.c: Asikwazi ukusho. Asikwazi ukunquma ukuthi isiphi sezaziso ezimbili esilungile.
e-07.s.s1.r.c: Izaziso ezimbili aziphikisani. U-B isaziso sakamuva esishintsha isikhathi sika-A.
e-07.s.s1.explain: Isaziso B sabekwa kamuva futhi sithi imizuzu eyi-10 ngaphambi kwesikhathi sika-A. Imizuzu eyi-10 ngaphambi kuka-7:40 ingu-7:30.
e-07.s.s2.prompt: UJae wathi, "On Friday it's the same time as Thursday." Ungawuhlulela kanjani lo mbono ngezaziso?
e-07.s.s2.hint.0: Zama ukushintshanisa u-'on Thursday' no-'from Thursday' bese uqhathanisa ukuthi incazelo iyashintsha yini.
e-07.s.s2.hint.1: Funa amagama esaziseni atshela ukuthi liphela nini.
e-07.s.s2.o.a: U-'From Thursday' usho ukuqhubeka kusukela ngoLwesine kuya phambili, ngakho uLwesihlanu ufana noLwesine.
e-07.s.s2.o.b: U-'From Thursday' usho ukuthi uLwesine kuphela oshintshayo ngalolo suku olulodwa.
e-07.s.s2.r.b: U-'From Thursday' no-'on Thursday' bahlukile. U-'From' ukhomba indawo yokuqala.
e-07.s.s2.o.c: ULwesihlanu awukho ngqo esaziseni, ngakho kubonakala udinga ukuhlola.
e-07.s.s2.r.c: Ukuqaphela kunengqondo. Kodwa isisho esithi 'From Thursday' sesivele sifaka izinsuku ezilandelayo.
e-07.s.s2.explain: U-'From Thursday' usho ukuthi isikhathi esisha sisebenza kusukela ngoLwesine. Uma kungekho gama elitshela ukuthi liphela nini, uLwesihlanu ufana. Ukucabanga ukubuza abasebenzi ngoba akubhalwanga ngqo nakho kunengqondo.
e-07.s.s2.acc.0: Ukufuna ukubuza abasebenzi ngoba uLwesihlanu akabhalwanga ngqo esaziseni nakho kunengqondo. Kodwa u-'From Thursday' ngokuvamile usho ukuthi kuyaqhubeka ngemva kwalokho.
e-07.s.s3.prompt: Phendula uHana ngesiNgisi. Sho ukuthi ibhasi lihamba nini ngoLwesine, futhi unikeze isizathu esisekelwe ezaziseni.
e-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngesikhathi sesaziso A, bese ubhala ukuthi isaziso B sithi sishintsha ini.
e-07.s.s3.hint.1: Engeza umusho owodwa othi 'kungani u-7:50 engalungile.'
e-07.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: I think it leaves at ... because ...
e-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe kucacile ukuthi ubufakazi bakho bavela kusiphi sezaziso ezimbili?
e-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi kungani u-7:50 engalungile?

e-08.title: Bhala isaziso seklabhu esingadidi
e-08.goal: Khomba ukuthi kungani isaziso esingacacile sidida, bese ubhala kabusha okufanayo ngesiNgisi ukuze noma ubani ofunda aqonde ngaphandle kwephutha.
e-08.material:
Lesi saziso sibekwe ebhodini lezaziso.

"Art Club meeting this Friday or next week at 3 or 4 in room 2 or the gym. Bring something."

Abangane abafunda lesi saziso baye ezindaweni ezahlukene futhi abakwazanga ukuhlangana.
e-08.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula izingxenye zesaziso eziqukethe u-'or', nezingxenye ezinamagama angacacile ongakwazi ukuqonda incazelo yawo (njengo-something).
e-08.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ingxenye ngengxenye ukuthi umfundi angakholwa uyodwa yini bese enza.
e-08.s.s1.r.a: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi usuku alucacile. Hlola ukuthi ezinye izinto zivumela umfundi ukuthi enze into eyodwa nazo yini.
e-08.s.s1.r.b: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi isikhathi asicacile. Hlola ukuthi ezinye izinto zivumela umfundi ukuthi enze into eyodwa nazo yini.
e-08.s.s1.r.c: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi indawo ayicacile. Hlola ukuthi ezinye izinto zivumela umfundi ukuthi enze into eyodwa nazo yini.
e-08.s.s1.r.d: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi okufanele kuzanywe akucacile. Hlola ukuthi ezinye izinto zivumela umfundi ukuthi enze into eyodwa nazo yini.
e-08.s.s1.r.e: Kucacile ukuthi ngumhlangano kabani. Khetha izingxenye kuphela umfundi angazingqonda ngezindlela ezimbili noma ngaphezulu.
e-08.s.s1.explain: Usuku, isikhathi, nendawo konke akucacile ngenxa ka-'or', futhi okufanele kuzanywe akucacile ngoba awukwazi ukuthi u-'something' uyini. Uma ukhethe ezinye kuphela, hlola futhi ukuthi umfundi angenza into eyodwa yini ngezinto owazishiya.
e-08.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kabusha isaziso somhlangano ofanayo ngesiNgisi ngaphandle kokungaqondi. Nquma futhi ubhale usuku, isikhathi, indawo, nokufanele kuzanywe.
e-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ekhanda lakho, yenza itafula lapho ulungisa into eyodwa ngosuku, isikhathi, indawo, nokufanele kuzanywe.
e-08.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi umngani ongakaze ayeke emhlanganweni angawuthola yini ngokusebenzisa lesi saziso kuphela.
e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe isaziso sakho sinengxenye lapho ubeka izinketho ezimbili nge-'or'? (Isibonelo, izikhathi ezimbili noma izindawo ezimbili)
e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngisho nomngani obona okokuqala, ingabe angasho ukuthi aye kuphi?
e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usuku (usuku lweviki) nesikhathi kubekwe kokunye?
e-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ithoni yobungane. I-'or' yalokho okumele kulethwe ukukhetha nje, ayinakho ukudideka.

e-11.title: Ukuhlola isimangalo 'Amamaki ehlile, ngakho yiphutha le-Wi-Fi'
e-11.goal: Hlola ukuthi ukucabanga kwembangela nomphumela encwadini yephephandaba lesikole kwanele yini, nquma ulwazi oludingekayo ukuhlola isimangalo, bese ubhalela umlobi ngenhlonipho ukuphikisa ngesiNgisi.
e-11.material:
Incwadi yomfundi wephephandaba lesikole (umbhalo wenganekwane):

"Last year, our school's average English score was 78. This year, after the school started free Wi-Fi, it fell to 72. So the Wi-Fi caused the drop. Therefore we should turn the Wi-Fi off."
e-11.prereq.0: Izinkulumo zembangela nomphumela ezinjengo-therefore / so / caused
e-11.prereq.1: Ukungavumelani ngenhlonipho (I see your point, however ...)
e-11.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umusho owodwa kulo mbhalo okhuluma sengathi liyiqiniso ngaphandle kobufakazi obanele.
e-11.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa umugqa ngamunye ube 'into eyenzekile' noma 'isimangalo mayelana nembangela noma lokho okufanele kwenziwe.'
e-11.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi imigqa yezimangalo ilandela imigqa yamaqiniso ayandulela yodwa yini.
e-11.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 ('So the Wi-Fi caused the drop.') ugxumela kusuka ku-'kwenzeke kamuva' kuya ku-'yimbangela.' Okuthi 'we should turn it off' emugqeni 4 nakho akunabo ubufakazi, kodwa kuncike ejumpini lomugqa 3. Imigqa 1 no-2 ngamazwi eqiniso ngamamaki nesikhathi.
e-11.s.s2.prompt: Yiluphi ulwazi olungakusiza uhlole ukuthi 'I-Wi-Fi yimbangela yokwehla kwamamaki'? Khetha konke okufanele.
e-11.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngezizathu ezimbili ngaphandle kwe-Wi-Fi zokuthi amamaki angashintsha.
e-11.s.s2.hint.1: Nquma ukuthi inketho ngayinye ingasiza yini ukuhlela ukuthi i-Wi-Fi noma esinye isizathu yimbangela.
e-11.s.s2.o.a: Ukuthi amamaki esiNgisi ashintshe kanjani ngonyaka ofanayo esikoleni esinye esingenayo i-Wi-Fi
e-11.s.s2.r.a: Ukuqhathanisa kuyindlela enhle. Bheka nokuthi ungahlola yini ukwehluka kobunzima bokuhlolwa noma eqenjini labafundi.
e-11.s.s2.o.b: Ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwesiNgisi kwalo nyaka bekunzima kunokonyaka odlule yini
e-11.s.s2.r.b: Uma ukuhlolwa kushintshile, kuyisizathu esibalulekile. Bheka nokuqhathanisa nezinye izikole neqembu labafundi.
e-11.s.s2.r.c: Ukuthi abafundi bathanda ikilasi kangakanani kungahlobana namamaki, kodwa akukwazi ukuhlela ukuthi i-Wi-Fi iyimbangela yini.
e-11.s.s2.r.d: Izindleko zihlobene nesinqumo sokuyifaka, kodwa azinasixhumanisi nokuthi kungani amamaki ehlile.
e-11.s.s2.o.e: Ukuthi abafundi bathi basebenzisa amafoni ngempela ngesikhathi sekilasi lesiNgisi yini
e-11.s.s2.r.e: Lolu ulwazi olubheka indlela. Bheka nezinye izizathu (ukuhlolwa, iqembu labafundi, ezinye izikole).
e-11.s.s2.o.f: Ukuthi abafundi balo nyaka bayiqembu elihlukile kubafundi bonyaka odlule yini (amakhono, inani lokufunda, njll.)
e-11.s.s2.explain: Ukuqhathanisa nezinye izikole (a), ukuhlola ubunzima bokuhlolwa (b), nokuhlola ukuthi bekusetshenziswa ngempela ngesikhathi sekilasi (e) nokwehluka kweqembu labafundi (f) kukuvumela ukuhlela ukuthi i-Wi-Fi noma esinye isizathu yimbangela. Inani labafundi abathanda ikilasi nezindleko zokufaka akuhlobene ngqo nembangela.
e-11.s.s2.acc.0: Ukuqhathanisa nezinye izikole nokuhlola ubunzima bokuhlolwa kuphela sekwanele ukusiza ukuhlela ezinye izizathu.
e-11.s.s2.acc.1: Uma uhlola nokuthi bekusetshenziswa ngempela ngesikhathi sekilasi, ungabona indlela i-Wi-Fi okungenzeka ngayo isebenze.
e-11.s.s2.acc.2: Ukwehluka kweqembu labafundi nakho yisizathu esinye esijwayelekile sokushintsha kwamamaki.
e-11.s.s3.prompt: Bhalela umlobi ukuphikisa kwemisho engu-2-3 ngesiNgisi. Yamukela iqiniso lokuthi amamaki ehlile, kodwa uchaze ukuthi isimangalo sokuthi i-Wi-Fi iyimbangela asikanele, futhi unikeze indlela eyodwa yokuhlola noma esinye isizathu.
e-11.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala, ngomusho owodwa, vuma ingxenye umlobi ayilungisile (amamaki ehlile).

e-12.title: Uma 'It's fine.' ingahle: ukwenza ingxoxo
e-12.goal: Hlulela ukuthi amagama anjengo-'It's fine.' angase angasho lokho akushoyo ngokoqobo, bese wenza ingxoxo emfushane yesiNgisi ngalolo hlobo lwesimo ukuze uhlangabezane nezimo.
e-12.material: U-A uthi ku-B, "I'm sorry I forgot to call you last night." U-B angaphendula lokhu ngezindlela eziningana. (Kubhalwe ngamagama kuphela.)
e-12.prereq.1: Izinkulumo ezinjenge-Are you sure? / You sound ...
e-12.s.s1.prompt: Kuzimpendulo zika-B, iyiphi engenzeka kakhulu ukuthi ize ilokhu ibonakala kulungile kuyilapho kungalungile?
e-12.s.s1.hint.0: Funda impendulo ngayinye ngokuzwakalayo, bese ucabange ukuthi umuntu olunge ngempela angayisho kanjalo yini.
e-12.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi impendulo ngayinye iqukethe yini 'isizathu sokuthi kulungile' noma 'okufunwayo', noma lokho kushodayo.
e-12.s.s1.r.a: Ikhuluma ngokungajwayelekile ngenkathi inikeza isizathu. Isizathu sokulunga sisemushweni.
e-12.s.s1.r.c: Ingase ibe nzima ngoba isho kakhulu, kodwa kunzima ukuhlulela umuzwa ngomusho kuphela.
e-12.s.s1.r.d: Isho ukuthi kulungile, kodwa futhi isho lokho ekufunayo. Ifihla okuncane.
e-12.s.s1.explain: Uma umuntu ethi kuphela 'It's fine.' emfushane, engahlanekile, asikho isizathu noma umuzwa obonakalayo, ngakho kulula ukufundwa njengokufihla umuzwa ongaphakathi. Kodwa awukwazi ukuqiniseka ngomusho kuphela, futhi kumele ubheke ithoni nomongo ndawonye.
e-12.s.s1.acc.0: 'Totally' egcizelelwe kakhulu ingaba uphawu lokumboza ukungalungi.
e-12.s.s1.acc.1: Ukuzindla ku-'Just...' kuphawu lokuthi umuntu akalungile ngokuphelele. Kodwa akunakwenzeka kangako, ngoba umuntu uyatshela ingxenye yalokho akuzwayo.
e-12.s.s2.prompt:
Yenza ingxoxo yesiNgisi ehlangabezana nezimo ezingezansi. Qala umugqa ngamunye nge-A: noma B:, bese ubhala okungenani imigqa engu-4.
Simo 1) U-B uthi kulungile ngamagama anjenge-'fine' noma 'okay', kodwa empeleni ubonakala ecasukile.
Simo 2) U-A ubona lokhu futhi ubuza ngobumnene (sebenzisa uphawu lombuzo).
Simo 3) Ekugcineni, u-B usho kancane ngokuthi uzwa kanjani ngempela.
e-12.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala khetha isimo esisodwa (ukukhohlwa isethembiso, isipho, umphumela wokuhlolwa, njll.).
e-12.s.s2.hint.1: Yenza impendulo yokuqala ka-B ibe mfushane, futhi uqale umbuzo ka-A kafushane, njenge-'Are you sure?'
e-12.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ungazizwa engxoxweni ukuthi amazwi ka-B ('fine') nomuzwa wangempela ka-B kuhlukile? Emugqeni muni?
e-12.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Emugqeni wokugcina, u-B usho kancane ngokuthi uzwa kanjani ngempela?
e-12.s.s2.modelNote.0: Ukugeleza lapho umuzwa wangempela ubonakala esimweni sokuxolisa.
e-12.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ingxoxo ehlangabezana nezimo ezifanayo ngesimo esihlukile.
